findings: IQ3_S beats IQ3_XXS by 21.7 percent in weight error at 12.2 percent more bytes, so IQ3_S is the best IQ3 arm for Strata.
down_proj cannot use a 256-block type at in_features 640, so IQ4_NL is the down role in both arms, matching the existing own-Coder recipe.
IQ4_XS beats IQ4_NL for gate_up on both error and bytes, so it is the 4-bit gate/up arm.

The reference IQ3 quantizer costs about a second per expert tensor, so full per-expert IQ QDQ across 13,824 experts is hours; the allocation ranking therefore reuses the measured MXFP4 QDQ sweep and the arms use exact Strata types and bytes.

method.library: tools/ggml/iq_qdq.c built against pinned llama.cpp 3cf0325 ggml-quants.c
method.quantizers: quantize_row_iq3_s_ref / iq3_xxs_ref / iq4_nl_ref / iq4_xs_ref, then the matching dequantizers

non_claims: Sample-based weight error, not end-to-end or MoE-block IQ3 error for every expert.
The allocation is derived from the MXFP4 QDQ ranking and has not been re-measured with IQ3 arms per expert.
No packed artifact or Strata engine run exists for this allocation.
question: Which IQ3 QDQ format is the best 3-bit arm for experts served through Strata?
